verses.uthmani: حمٓ
verses.indopak: حٰمٓ ۚ
verses.transliteration: ﻿<u>ha</u>meem
verses.saheeh: Ha, Meem.
verses.khattab: Ḥâ-Mĩm
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Hā mīm: God knows best what He means by these [letters].
verses.romanUrdu: Haa Meem

verses.uthmani: تَنزِيلُ ٱلۡكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلۡعَزِيزِ ٱلۡحَكِيمِ
verses.indopak: تَنْزِيْلُ الْكِتٰبِ مِنَ اللّٰهِ الْعَزِيْزِ الْحَكِيْمِ
verses.transliteration: tanzeelu alkitabi mina allahi al'azeezi alhakeemi
verses.saheeh: The revelation of the Book is from Allah, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.khattab: The revelation of this Book is from Allah—the Almighty, All-Wise
verses.jalalayn: ﻿The revelation of the Book, the Qur'an (tanzīlu’l-kitābi, the subject) is from God (mina’Llāhi, the predicate thereof) the Mighty, in His kingdom, the Wise, in His actions.
verses.romanUrdu: Is kitaab ka nuzul Allah ki taraf se hai jo zabardast aur Hakeem hai

verses.uthmani: إِنَّ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّلْمُؤْمِنِيْنَ ۗ
verses.transliteration: inna fee alssamawati waalardi laayatin lilmumineena
verses.saheeh: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.
verses.khattab: Surely in ˹the creation of˺ the heavens and the earth are signs for the believers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Truly in the heavens and the earth, that is to say, in their creation, there are signs, indicating the power of God and His Oneness, exalted be He, for believers.
verses.romanUrdu: Haqeeqat yeh hai ke aasmaano aur zameen mein beshumaar nishaniyan hain iman laney walon ke liye

verses.uthmani: وَفِي خَلۡقِكُمۡ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِن دَآبَّةٍ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُوقِنُونَ
verses.indopak: وَفِىْ خَلْقِكُمْ وَمَا يَبُثُّ مِنْ دَاۤبَّةٍ اٰيٰتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُّوْقِنُوْنَ ۙ
verses.transliteration: wafee khalqikum wama yabuththu min dabbatin ayatun liqawmin yooqinoona
verses.saheeh: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].
verses.khattab: And in your own creation, and whatever living beings He dispersed, are signs for people of sure faith
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And in your creation, that is to say, and in the creation of every one of you from a sperm-drop, then a blood clot, then an embryo until it becomes a human being; and, [in] the creation of, what He has scattered, [what] He has dispersed throughout the earth, of animals — [dābba denotes] whatever treads on (yadubbu) the earth of [both] human beings and other [animals] — there are signs for a people who are certain, of the Resurrection;
verses.romanUrdu: Aur tumhari apni paidaish mein, aur un haiwanaat(janwaron) mein jinko Allah (zameen mein) phayla raha hai, badi nishaniyan hain un logon ke liye jo yaqeen laney waley hain

verses.uthmani: وَٱخۡتِلَٰفِ ٱلَّيۡلِ وَٱلنَّهَارِ وَمَآ أَنزَلَ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مِن رِّزۡقٖ فَأَحۡيَا بِهِ ٱلۡأَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَا وَتَصۡرِيفِ ٱلرِّيَٰحِ ءَايَٰتٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَعۡقِلُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاخْتِلَافِ الَّيْلِ وَالنَّهَارِ وَمَاۤ اَنْزَلَ اللّٰهُ مِنَ السَّمَاۤءِ مِنْ رِّزْقٍ فَاَحْيَا بِهِ الْاَرْضَ بَعْدَ مَوْتِهَا وَ تَصْرِيْفِ الرِّيٰحِ اٰيٰتٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يَّعْقِلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waikhtilafi allayli waalnnahari wama anzala allahu mina alssamai min rizqin faahya bihi alarda ba'da mawtiha watasreefi alrriyahi ayatun liqawmin ya'qiloona
verses.saheeh: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what Allah sends down from the sky of provision and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.
verses.khattab: And ˹in˺ the alternation of the day and the night, the provision sent down from the skies by Allah—reviving the earth after its death—and the shifting of the winds, are signs for people of understanding
verses.jalalayn: ﻿and, in, the alternation of night and day, their passing and their arrival, and what God sends down from the heaven [in the way] of provision, rain, for it constitutes a means of provision, with which He revives the earth after it is dead, and the circulation of the winds, its alternation between southerly and northerly, hot and cold, there are signs for a people who understand, proofs and therefore have faith.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur shab-o-roz (night and day) ke farq o ikhtilaf mein, aur us rizq mein jisey Allah aasmaan se nazil farmata hai phir uske zariye se murda zameen ko jila uthata hai, aur hawaon ki gardish mein bahut nishaniyan hain un logon ke liye jo aqal se kaam letey hain

verses.uthmani: تِلۡكَ ءَايَٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتۡلُوهَا عَلَيۡكَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ ۖ فَبِأَيِّ حَدِيثِۭ بَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ وَءَايَٰتِهِۦ يُؤۡمِنُونَ
verses.indopak: تِلْكَ اٰيٰتُ اللّٰهِ نَـتْلُوْهَا عَلَيْكَ بِالْحَقِّ ۚ فَبِاَىِّ حَدِيْثٍۢ بَعْدَ اللّٰهِ وَاٰيٰتِهٖ يُؤْمِنُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: tilka ayatu allahi natlooha 'alayka bialhaqqi fabiayyi hadeethin ba'da allahi waayatihi yuminoona
verses.saheeh: These are the verses of Allah which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after Allah and His verses will they believe?
verses.khattab: These are Allah’s revelations which We recite to you ˹O Prophet˺ in truth. So what message will they believe in after ˹denying˺ Allah and His revelations
verses.jalalayn: ﻿These, mentioned signs, are the signs of God, the proofs of His that indicate His Oneness, which We recite, relate, to you with truth (bi’l-haqqi is semantically connected to natlū, ‘We recite’). So in what [kind of] discourse then, after God, that is to say, [after] His discourse, namely, the Qur'an, and His signs, His definitive arguments, will they, that is, the disbelievers of Mecca, believe? In other words: they will not believe [in anything] (a variant reading [for yu’minūna, ‘they believe’] has tu’minūna, ‘you believe’).
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh Allah ki nishaniyan hain jinhein hum tumhare saamne theek theek bayan kar rahey hain. Ab aakhir Allah aur uski aayat ke baad aur kaunsi baat hai jispar yeh log imaan layenge

verses.uthmani: وَيۡلٞ لِّكُلِّ أَفَّاكٍ أَثِيمٖ
verses.indopak: وَيْلٌ لِّـكُلِّ اَفَّاكٍ اَثِيْمٍ ۙ
verses.transliteration: waylun likulli affakin atheemin
verses.saheeh: Woe to every sinful liar
verses.khattab: Woe to every sinful liar
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Woe (waylun is an expression implying chastisement) to every sinful liar,
verses.romanUrdu: Tabahi hai har us jhoote badh amal shaks ke liye

verses.uthmani: يَسۡمَعُ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسۡتَكۡبِرٗا كَأَن لَّمۡ يَسۡمَعۡهَا ۖ فَبَشِّرۡهُ بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٖ
verses.indopak: يَّسْمَعُ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ تُتْلٰى عَلَيْهِ ثُمَّ يُصِرُّ مُسْتَكْبِرًا كَاَنْ لَّمْ يَسْمَعْهَا ۚ فَبَشِّرْهُ بِعَذَابٍ اَ لِيْمٍ
verses.transliteration: yasma'u ayati allahi tutla 'alayhi thumma yusirru mustakbiran kaan lam yasma'ha fabashshirhu bi'athabin aleemin
verses.saheeh: Who hears the verses of Allah recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
verses.khattab: They hear Allah’s revelations recited to them, then persist ˹in denial˺ arrogantly as if they did not hear them. So give them good news of a painful punishment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿who hears the signs of God, the Qur'an, being recited to him, then persists, in his disbelief, arrogantly, disdainful of faith, as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful chastisement.
verses.romanUrdu: Jiske saamne Allah ki aayat padi jaati hain, aur woh unko sunta hai, phir puray istakbar ke saath apne kufr par is tarah ada rehta hai goya usne unko suna hi nahin. Aise shaks ko dardnaak azaab ka musda suna do

verses.uthmani: وَإِذَا عَلِمَ مِنۡ ءَايَٰتِنَا شَيۡـًٔا ٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا ۚ أُوْلَٰٓئِكَ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مُّهِينٞ
verses.indopak: وَاِذَا عَلِمَ مِنْ اٰيٰتِنَا شَيْــًٔـاٱتَّخَذَهَا هُزُوًا ۗ اُولٰۤٮِٕكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مُّهِيْنٌ ۗ
verses.transliteration: waitha 'alima min ayatina shayan ittakhathaha huzuwan olaika lahum 'athabun muheenun
verses.saheeh: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.
verses.khattab: And whenever they learn anything of Our revelations, they make a mockery of it. It is they who will suffer a humiliating punishment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And should he come to know anything of Our signs, namely, the Qur'an, he takes them in mockery. For such, liars — there is a degrading chastisement.
verses.romanUrdu: Hamari aayat mein se koi baat jab uske ilm mein aati hai to woh unka mazaak bana leta hain. Aisey sab logon ke liye zillat ka azaab hai

verses.uthmani: مِّن وَرَآئِهِمۡ جَهَنَّمُ ۖ وَلَا يُغۡنِي عَنۡهُم مَّا كَسَبُواْ شَيۡـٔٗا وَلَا مَا ٱتَّخَذُواْ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ أَوۡلِيَآءَ ۖ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.indopak: مِنْ وَّرَاۤٮِٕهِمْ جَهَنَّمُ ۚ وَلَا يُغْنِىْ عَنْهُمْ مَّا كَسَبُوْا شَيْــًٔـا وَّلَا مَا اتَّخَذُوْا مِنْ دُوْنِ اللّٰهِ اَوْلِيَاۤءَ ۚ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيْمٌ ۗ
verses.transliteration: min waraihim jahannamu wala yughnee 'anhum ma kasaboo shayan wala ma ittakhathoo min dooni allahi awliyaa walahum 'athabun 'atheemun
verses.saheeh: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides Allah as allies. And they will have a great punishment.
verses.khattab: Awaiting them is Hell. Their ˹worldly˺ gains will not be of any benefit to them whatsoever, nor will those protectors they have taken besides Allah. And they will suffer a tremendous punishment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Beyond them, that is to say, ahead of them — because they are [still] in this world — is Hell, and that which they have earned, of wealth and deeds, will not avail them in any way, nor those whom they took besides God, that is, idols, as patrons. And for them there will be a great chastisement.
verses.romanUrdu: Unke aage jahannum hai. Jo kuch bhi unhone duniya mein kamaya hai usmein se koi cheez unke kisi kaam na aayegi. Na unke woh sarparast hi unke liye kuch kar sakenge jinhein Allah ko chodh kar unhon ne apna wali bana rakkha hai. Unke liye bada azaab hai

verses.uthmani: هَٰذَا هُدٗى ۖ وَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُواْ بِـَٔايَٰتِ رَبِّهِمۡ لَهُمۡ عَذَابٞ مِّن رِّجۡزٍ أَلِيمٌ
verses.indopak: هٰذَا هُدًى ۚ وَالَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْا بِاٰيٰتِ رَبِّهِمْ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ مِّنْ رِّجْزٍ اَلِيْمٌ
verses.transliteration: hatha hudan waallatheena kafaroo biayati rabbihim lahum 'athabun min rijzin aleemin
verses.saheeh: This [Qur'an] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.
verses.khattab: This ˹Quran˺ is ˹true˺ guidance. And those who deny their Lord’s revelations will suffer the ˹worst˺ torment of agonizing pain
verses.jalalayn: ﻿This, that is, the Qur'an, is a guidance, from error; and those who disbelieve in the signs of their Lord, for them there will be a torture, a lot, of a painful, an excruciating, chastisement.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh Quran sarasar hidayat hai, aur un logon ke liye balaa ka dardnaak azaab hai jinhon ne apne Rubb ki aayat ko maan-ne se inkar kiya

verses.uthmani: ۞ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَكُمُ ٱلۡبَحۡرَ لِتَجۡرِيَ ٱلۡفُلۡكُ فِيهِ بِأَمۡرِهِۦ وَلِتَبۡتَغُواْ مِن فَضۡلِهِۦ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُونَ
verses.indopak: ۞ اَللّٰهُ الَّذِىْ سَخَّرَ لَـكُمُ الْبَحْرَ لِتَجْرِىَ الْفُلْكُ فِيْهِ بِاَمْرِهٖ وَلِتَبْتَغُوْا مِنْ فَضْلِهٖ وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُوْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: allahu allathee sakhkhara lakumu albahra litajriya alfulku feehi biamrihi walitabtaghoo min fadlihi wala'allakum tashkuroona
verses.saheeh: It is Allah who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
verses.khattab: Allah is the One Who has subjected the sea for you so that ships may sail upon it by His command, and that you may seek His bounty, and that perhaps you will be grateful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿God it is Who disposed for you the sea so that the ships may sail upon it by His command, by His permission, and that you may seek, that you may request, by way of trade, of His bounty, and that perhaps you may give thanks.
verses.romanUrdu: Woh Allah hi to hai jisne tumhare liye samandar ko musakkhar kiya taa-ke uske hukum se kashtiyan usmein chalein aur tum uska fazal talash karo aur shukar guzar ho

verses.uthmani: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُم مَّا فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِي ٱلۡأَرۡضِ جَمِيعٗا مِّنۡهُ ۚ إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَأٓيَٰتٖ لِّقَوۡمٖ يَتَفَكَّرُونَ
verses.indopak: وَسَخَّرَ لَـكُمْ مَّا فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِى الْاَرْضِ جَمِيْعًا مِّنْهُ ۗ اِنَّ فِىْ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوْمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: wasakhkhara lakum ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi jamee'an minhu inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yatafakkaroona
verses.saheeh: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
verses.khattab: He ˹also˺ subjected for you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth—all by His grace. Surely in this are signs for people who reflect
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And He has disposed for you whatever is in the heavens, of sun, moon, stars, water and otherwise, and whatever is in the earth, of animals, trees, vegetation, rivers and otherwise, that is to say, He created [all] that for your benefit, all (jamī‘an is for emphasis) being from Him (minhu is a circumstantial qualifier, that is to say, He has disposed them as something from Him, exalted be He). Surely in that there are signs for a people who reflect, on them and therefore believe.
verses.romanUrdu: Usne zameen aur aasmaano ki saari hi cheezon ko tumhare liye musakkhar kardiya, sab kuch apne paas se. Ismein badi nishaniyan hai un logon ke lye jo gaur o fikr karne wale hain

verses.uthmani: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ يَغۡفِرُواْ لِلَّذِينَ لَا يَرۡجُونَ أَيَّامَ ٱللَّهِ لِيَجۡزِيَ قَوۡمَۢا بِمَا كَانُواْ يَكۡسِبُونَ
verses.indopak: قُلْ لِّلَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا يَغْفِرُوْا لِلَّذِيْنَ لَا يَرْجُوْنَ اَيَّامَ اللّٰهِ لِيَجْزِىَ قَوْمًا بِۢمَا كَانُوْا يَكْسِبُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: qul lillatheena amanoo yaghfiroo lillatheena la yarjoona ayyama allahi liyajziya qawman bima kanoo yaksiboona
verses.saheeh: Say, [O Muhammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of Allah so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
verses.khattab: ˹O Prophet!˺ Tell the believers to forgive those who do not fear Allah’s days ˹of torment˺, so that He will reward each group for what they used to commit
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Tell those who believe to forgive those who do not anticipate, [those who do not] fear, the days of God, the events which He precipitates, that is to say, forgive the disbelievers the harm which they have caused you — this was before the command to struggle against them [had been revealed] — that He, God, may requite (a variant reading [for li-yajziya] has li-najziya, ‘that We may requite’) a people for what they used to earn, when they used to forgive disbelievers the harm which they did.
verses.romanUrdu: (Aey Nabi) imaan laney walon se kehdo ke jo log Allah ki taraf se bure din aane ka koi andesha nahin rakhte, unki harakaton par darguzar se kaam lein taa-ke Allah khud ek giroh ko uski kamayi ka badla de

verses.uthmani: مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحٗا فَلِنَفۡسِهِۦ ۖ وَمَنۡ أَسَآءَ فَعَلَيۡهَا ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىٰ رَبِّكُمۡ تُرۡجَعُونَ
verses.indopak: مَنْ عَمِلَ صَالِحًـا فَلِنَفْسِهٖ ۚ وَمَنْ اَسَاۤءَ فَعَلَيْهَا ۖ ثُمَّ اِلٰى رَبِّكُمْ تُرْجَعُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: man 'amila salihan falinafsihi waman asaa fa'alayha thumma ila rabbikum turja'oona
verses.saheeh: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against the self. Then to your Lord you will be returned.
verses.khattab: Whoever does good, it is to their own benefit. And whoever does evil, it is to their own loss. Then to your Lord you will ˹all˺ be returned
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Whoever acts righteously, it is for [the benefit of] his own soul, that he acts [so], and whoever does evil, it is to the detriment thereof, that he has done evil; then to your Lord you will be returned, [with your Lord] you shall end up, whereupon He will requite the one of righteous deeds and the evildoer.
verses.romanUrdu: Jo koi neik amal karega apne hi liye karega, aur jo burai karega woh aap hi uska khumyaza (consequence) bhugtega. Phir jaana to sabko apne Rubb hi ki taraf hai

wbw.translation: then it is for his soul

verses.uthmani: وَلَقَدۡ ءَاتَيۡنَا بَنِيٓ إِسۡرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلۡكِتَٰبَ وَٱلۡحُكۡمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقۡنَٰهُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ وَفَضَّلۡنَٰهُمۡ عَلَى ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.indopak: وَلَقَدْ اٰتَيْنَا بَنِىْۤ اِسْرَاۤءِيْلَ الْكِتٰبَ وَالْحُكْمَ وَالنُّبُوَّةَ وَرَزَقْنٰهُمْ مِّنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِ وَفَضَّلْنٰهُمْ عَلَى الْعٰلَمِيْنَ ۚ
verses.transliteration: walaqad atayna banee israeela alkitaba waalhukma waalnnubuwwata warazaqnahum mina alttayyibati wafaddalnahum 'ala al'alameena
verses.saheeh: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.
verses.khattab: Indeed, We gave the Children of Israel the Scripture, wisdom, and prophethood; granted them good, lawful provisions; and favoured them above the others
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And verily We gave the Children of Israel the Scripture, the Torah, and [the means of] judgement, therewith between people, and prophethood, for Moses and Aaron among them, and We provided them with the good things, the lawful things, such as manna and quails, and We favoured them above [all] worlds, the worlds of their time, [that is, above all other] rational beings.
verses.romanUrdu: Issey pehle bani Israel ko humne kitaab aur hukum aur nabuwat ata ki thi, unko humne umda samaan e zeist se nawaza, duniya bhar ke logon par unhein fazilat ata ki

verses.uthmani: وَءَاتَيۡنَٰهُم بَيِّنَٰتٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ ۖ فَمَا ٱخۡتَلَفُوٓاْ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلۡعِلۡمُ بَغۡيَۢا بَيۡنَهُمۡ ۚ إِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقۡضِي بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ فِيمَا كَانُواْ فِيهِ يَخۡتَلِفُونَ
verses.indopak: وَاٰتَيْنٰهُمْ بَيِّنٰتٍ مِّنَ الْاَمْرِ ۚ فَمَا اخْتَلَفُوْۤا اِلَّا مِنْۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَاۤءَهُمُ الْعِلْمُ ۙ بَغْيًاۢ بَيْنَهُمْ ۗ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ يَقْضِىْ بَيْنَهُمْ يَوْمَ الْقِيٰمَةِ فِيْمَا كَانُوْا فِيْهِ يَخْتَلِفُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waataynahum bayyinatin mina alamri fama ikhtalafoo illa min ba'di ma jaahumu al'ilmu baghyan baynahum inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum yawma alqiyamati feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoona
verses.saheeh: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
verses.khattab: We ˹also˺ gave them clear commandments regarding ˹their˺ faith. But it was not until knowledge came to them that they differed out of mutual envy. Surely your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Judgment regarding their differences
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And We gave them clear illustrations of the commandment, the commandment of religion, in the way of what is lawful or unlawful, and the Mission of Muhammad (s), upon whom be the most excellent blessings and peace. And they did not differ, regarding his Mission, except after the knowledge had come to them, out of rivalry among themselves, that is to say, because of some rivalry that came about among them, out of envy of him. Surely your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that in which they used to differ.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur deen ke maamle mein unhein wazeh hidayat de di.Phir jo ikhtilaf unke darmiyan runama hua woh (nawaqifiyat ki wajah se nahin balke) ilm aa jaaney ke baad hua aur us bina par hua ke woh aapas mein ek dusre par zyadati karna chahte thay. Allah qayamat ke roz un maamlaat ka faisla farmadega jinmein woh ikhtilaf karte rahey hain

verses.uthmani: ثُمَّ جَعَلۡنَٰكَ عَلَىٰ شَرِيعَةٖ مِّنَ ٱلۡأَمۡرِ فَٱتَّبِعۡهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعۡ أَهۡوَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
verses.indopak: ثُمَّ جَعَلْنٰكَ عَلٰى شَرِيْعَةٍ مِّنَ الْاَمْرِ فَاتَّبِعْهَا وَلَا تَتَّبِعْ اَهْوَاۤءَ الَّذِيْنَ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: thumma ja'alnaka 'ala sharee'atin mina alamri faittabi'ha wala tattabi' ahwaa allatheena la ya'lamoona
verses.saheeh: Then We put you, [O Muhammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.
verses.khattab: Now We have set you ˹O Prophet˺ on the ˹clear˺ Way of faith. So follow it, and do not follow the desires of those who do not know ˹the truth˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Then We set you, O Muhammad (s), upon a [clear] course, [a clear] way, of the commandment, the commandment of religion; so follow it, and do not follow the desires of those who do not know, in worshipping other than God.
verses.romanUrdu: Iske baad aey Nabi humne tumko din ke maamley mein ek saaf shah-raah(shariyat) par qayam kiya hai. Lihaza tum usi par chalo aur un logon ki khwahishat ka ittiba na karo jo ilm nahin rakhte

verses.uthmani: إِنَّهُمۡ لَن يُغۡنُواْ عَنكَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيۡـٔٗا ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ أَوۡلِيَآءُ بَعۡضٖ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِيُّ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
verses.indopak: اِنَّهُمْ لَنْ يُّغْنُوْا عَنْكَ مِنَ اللّٰهِ شَيْــًٔـا ۗ وَ اِنَّ الظّٰلِمِيْنَ بَعْضُهُمْ اَوْلِيَاۤءُ بَعْضٍ ۚ وَاللّٰهُ وَلِىُّ الْمُتَّقِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: innahum lan yughnoo 'anka mina allahi shayan wainna alththalimeena ba'duhum awliyao ba'din waallahu waliyyu almuttaqeena
verses.saheeh: Indeed, they will never avail you against Allah at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but Allah is the protector of the righteous.
verses.khattab: They certainly can be of no benefit to you against Allah whatsoever. Surely the wrongdoers are patrons of each other, whereas Allah is the Patron of the righteous
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Assuredly they will not avail, they [will not] protect, you in any way against God, against His chastisement. And assuredly the wrongdoers, the disbelievers, are allies of one another; but God is the ally [only] of the God-fearing.
verses.romanUrdu: Allah ke muqable mein woh tumhare kuch bhi kaam nahin aa sakte. Zaalim log ek dusre ke saathi hain, aur muttaaqiyon ka saathi Allah hai

verses.uthmani: هَٰذَا بَصَٰٓئِرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدٗى وَرَحۡمَةٞ لِّقَوۡمٖ يُوقِنُونَ
verses.indopak: هٰذَا بَصَاۤٮِٕرُ لِلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَّرَحْمَةٌ لِّقَوْمٍ يُّوْقِنُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: hatha basairu lilnnasi wahudan warahmatun liqawmin yooqinoona
verses.saheeh: This [Qur'an] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].
verses.khattab: This ˹Quran˺ is an insight for humanity—a guide and mercy for people of sure faith
verses.jalalayn: ﻿This, Qur'an, is [a set of] insights for mankind, guideposts with which they can discern [God’s] rulings and legal proscriptions, and guidance and mercy for a people who have certainty, with regard to the [truth of the] Resurrection.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh basirat ki roshiniyan hain sab logon ke liye aur hidayat aur rehmat un logon ke liye jo yaqeen layein

verses.uthmani: أَمۡ حَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱجۡتَرَحُواْ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ أَن نَّجۡعَلَهُمۡ كَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ سَوَآءٗ مَّحۡيَاهُمۡ وَمَمَاتُهُمۡ ۚ سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُونَ
verses.indopak: اَمْ حَسِبَ الَّذِيْنَ اجْتَـرَحُوا السَّيِّاٰتِ اَنْ نَّجْعَلَهُمْ كَالَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ ۙ سَوَاۤءً مَّحْيَاهُمْ وَمَمَاتُهُمْ ۗ سَاۤءَ مَا يَحْكُمُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: am hasiba allatheena ijtarahoo alssayyiati an naj'alahum kaallatheena amanoo wa'amiloo alssalihati sawaan mahyahum wamamatuhum saa ma yahkumoona
verses.saheeh: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge.
verses.khattab: Or do those who commit evil deeds ˹simply˺ think that We will make them equal—in their life and after their death—to those who believe and do good? How wrong is their judgment
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Or (am has the significance of the [rhetorical] hamza of denial) do those who have perpetrated evil acts, [such as] disbelief and disobedience, suppose that We shall treat them as those who believe and perform righteous deeds, equally (sawā’an is the predicate) in their life and in their death? (mahyāhum wa-mamātuhum, [this clause] constitutes the subject and a supplement; the sentence [itself] is a substitution for the kāf [of ka’lladhīna, ‘as those’], and both [suffixed] pronouns [-hum] refer to the disbelievers). The meaning is: do they suppose that in the Hereafter We will assign them [a] good [fate] like believers, [that they will enjoy] a life of plenty, one equal to their life in this world, as when they said to the believers: ‘Surely if we were to be resurrected, we will be given the same good things that you will be given!’ God, exalted be He, says, in accordance with His denial [implicit] in the [rhetorical interrogative] hamza: How evil is that judgement which they make! In other words, it will not be so, for in the Hereafter they will be [suffering] in the chastisement, in contrast to their lives in this world; the believers, on the other hand, will be [delighting] in the Reward in the Hereafter because of their righteous deeds in this world, such as [their observance of] prayers, [their] alms-giving, fasting and otherwise (the mā, ‘that … which’, relates to the verbal action, that is to say, ba’isa hukman hukmuhum hādhā, ‘awful as a judgement is this judgement of theirs’).
verses.romanUrdu: Kya woh log jinhon ne buraiyon ka irtiqaab kiya hai yeh samjhe baithay hain ke hum unhein aur imaan laney walon aur neik amal karne walon ko ek jaisa kardenge ke inka jeena aur marna yaksan ho jaye? Bahut burey hukum hain jo yeh log lagate hain

verses.uthmani: وَخَلَقَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ بِٱلۡحَقِّ وَلِتُجۡزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفۡسِۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُونَ
verses.indopak: وَ خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضَ بِالْحَقِّ وَلِتُجْزٰى كُلُّ نَفْسٍ بِۢمَا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: wakhalaqa allahu alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi walitujza kullu nafsin bima kasabat wahum la yuthlamoona
verses.saheeh: And Allah created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
verses.khattab: For Allah created the heavens and the earth for a purpose, so that every soul may be paid back for what it has committed. And none will be wronged
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And God created the heavens and, He created, the earth with the truth (bi’l-haqqi is semantically connected to khalaqa, ‘He created’), so that He may indicate His power and His Oneness, and so that every soul may be requited for what it has earned, in the way of acts of disobedience or obedience, and therefore the disbeliever cannot be equal to the believer, and they will not be wronged.
verses.romanUrdu: Allah ne to Aasmaano aur zameen ko barhaqq paida kiya hai aur is liye kiya hai ke har mutannafis ko uski kamayi ka badla diya jaye. Logon par zulm hargiz na kiya jayega

verses.uthmani: أَفَرَءَيۡتَ مَنِ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَٰهَهُۥ هَوَىٰهُ وَأَضَلَّهُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ عِلۡمٖ وَخَتَمَ عَلَىٰ سَمۡعِهِۦ وَقَلۡبِهِۦ وَجَعَلَ عَلَىٰ بَصَرِهِۦ غِشَٰوَةٗ فَمَن يَهۡدِيهِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ أَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُونَ
verses.indopak: اَفَرَءَيْتَ مَنِ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰهَهٗ هَوٰٮهُ وَاَضَلَّهُ اللّٰهُ عَلٰى عِلْمٍ وَّخَتَمَ عَلٰى سَمْعِهٖ وَقَلْبِهٖ وَجَعَلَ عَلٰى بَصَرِهٖ غِشٰوَةً ۗ فَمَنْ يَّهْدِيْهِ مِنْۢ بَعْدِ اللّٰهِ ۗ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: afaraayta mani ittakhatha ilahahu hawahu waadallahu allahu 'ala 'ilmin wakhatama 'ala sam'ihi waqalbihi waja'ala 'ala basarihi ghishawatan faman yahdeehi min ba'di allahi afala tathakkaroona
verses.saheeh: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and Allah has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after Allah? Then will you not be reminded?
verses.khattab: Have you seen ˹O Prophet˺ those who have taken their own desires as their god? ˹And so˺ Allah left them to stray knowingly, sealed their hearing and hearts, and placed a cover on their sight. Who then can guide them after Allah? Will you ˹all˺ not then be mindful
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Have you then seen, inform Me [about], him who has taken as his god his [own] desire, [that is] whatever [new] stone he may desire after [having desired] some other stone, considering this [new one] to be better, and whom God has led astray knowingly, on His part, exalted be He, that is to say, knowing him to be of those who follow misguidance before he was created, and set a seal upon his hearing and his heart, so that he cannot hear guidance or understand it, and laid a covering, a darkness, over his sight?, so that he cannot perceive guidance (here one should understand as implied the second direct object of [the verb] a-ra’ayta, ‘have you seen’, namely: a-yahtadī, ‘can he find guidance?). So who will guide him after God?, that is to say, after His leading him astray? In other words, he will not find guidance. Will you not then remember?, [will you not then] be admonished? (tadhakkarūna: one of the two tā’ letters [of the original form tatadhakkarūna] has been assimilated with the dhāl).
verses.romanUrdu: Phir kya tumne kabhi us shaks ke haal par bhi gaur kiya jisne apni khwahish e nafs ko apna khuda bana liya aur Allah ne ilm ke bawajood usey gumrahi mein phenk diya aur uske dil aur kaano (ears) par mohar laga di aur uski aankhon par purdah daal diya? Allah ke baad ab aur kaun hai jo usey hidayat de? Kya tum log koi sabaq nahin letay

wbw.translation: and Allah lets him go astray
and Allah lets him go astray

verses.uthmani: وَقَالُواْ مَا هِيَ إِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا ٱلدُّنۡيَا نَمُوتُ وَنَحۡيَا وَمَا يُهۡلِكُنَآ إِلَّا ٱلدَّهۡرُ ۚ وَمَا لَهُم بِذَٰلِكَ مِنۡ عِلۡمٍ ۖ إِنۡ هُمۡ إِلَّا يَظُنُّونَ
verses.indopak: وَقَالُوْا مَا هِىَ اِلَّا حَيَاتُنَا الدُّنْيَا نَمُوْتُ وَنَحْيَا وَمَا يُهْلِكُنَاۤ اِلَّا الدَّهْرُ ۗ وَمَا لَهُمْ بِذٰلِكَ مِنْ عِلْمٍ ۚ اِنْ هُمْ اِلَّا يَظُنُّوْنَ
verses.transliteration: waqaloo ma hiya illa hayatuna alddunya namootu wanahya wama yuhlikuna illa alddahru wama lahum bithalika min 'ilmin in hum illa yathunnoona
verses.saheeh: And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time." And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.
verses.khattab: And they argue, “There is nothing beyond our worldly life. We die; others are born. And nothing destroys us but ˹the passage of˺ time.” Yet they have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this ˹claim˺. They only speculate
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And they, those who deny the Resurrection, say, ‘There is only, that is to say, [the only] life [is], our life, the one that is, in this world. We die and we live, that is to say, some die, while others are given life by [virtue of] being born, and nothing but time, that is, [nothing but] the passage of time, destroys us’. God, exalted be He, says: Of that, saying, they have no knowledge; they are only making conjectures.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh log kehte hain ke “zindagi bas yahi hamari duniya ki zindagi hai, yahin hamara marna aur jeena hai aur gardish-e-ayyam ( passage of time) ke siwa koi cheez nahin ho humein halaak karti ho.” Dar haqeeqat is maamle mein inke paas koi ilm nahin hai yeh mehaz gumaan ki bina par yeh baatein karte hain

verses.uthmani: وَإِذَا تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡهِمۡ ءَايَٰتُنَا بَيِّنَٰتٖ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمۡ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُواْ ٱئۡتُواْ بِـَٔابَآئِنَآ إِن كُنتُمۡ صَٰدِقِينَ
verses.indopak: وَاِذَا تُتْلٰى عَلَيْهِمْ اٰيٰتُنَا بَيِّنٰتٍ مَّا كَانَ حُجَّتَهُمْ اِلَّاۤ اَنْ قَالُوا ائْتُوْا بِاٰبَاۤٮِٕنَاۤ اِنْ كُنْتُمْ صٰدِقِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: waitha tutla 'alayhim ayatuna bayyinatin ma kana hujjatahum illa an qaloo itoo biabaina in kuntum sadiqeena
verses.saheeh: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
verses.khattab: And whenever Our clear revelations are recited to them, their only argument is to say: “Bring our forefathers back, if what you say is true!”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And when Our signs, of the Qur'an, indicating Our power to resurrect, are recited to them, being clear signs, evident [signs] (bayyinātin, ‘clear signs’, is a circumstantial qualifier), their only argument is to say, ‘Bring us our fathers, alive, if you are being truthful’, [when you say] that we will be resurrected.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jab hamari wazeh aayat unhein sunayi jaati hain to inke paas koi hujjat iske siwa nahin hoti ke utha lao hamare baap dada ko agar tum sacche ho

verses.uthmani: قُلِ ٱللَّهُ يُحۡيِيكُمۡ ثُمَّ يُمِيتُكُمۡ ثُمَّ يَجۡمَعُكُمۡ إِلَىٰ يَوۡمِ ٱلۡقِيَٰمَةِ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكۡثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُونَ
verses.indopak: قُلِ اللّٰهُ يُحْيِيْكُمْ ثُمَّ يُمِيْتُكُمْ ثُمَّ يَجْمَعُكُمْ اِلٰى يَوْمِ الْقِيٰمَةِ لَا رَيْبَ فِيْهِ وَلٰكِنَّ اَكْثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: quli allahu yuhyeekum thumma yumeetukum thumma yajma'ukum ila yawmi alqiyamati la rayba feehi walakinna akthara alnnasi la ya'lamoona
verses.saheeh: Say, "Allah causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."
verses.khattab: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “˹It is˺ Allah ˹Who˺ gives you life, then causes you to die, then will gather you ˹all˺ on the Day of Judgment, about which there is no doubt. But most people do not know.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿Say: ‘God [is the One Who] gives you life, when you are sperm-drops, then makes you die, then gathers you, alive, to the Day of Resurrection, in which there is no doubt; but most people, and these are the one who say the above-mentioned, do not know’.
verses.romanUrdu: Aey Nabi insey kaho Allah hi tumhein zindagi bakashta hai, phir wahi tumhein maut deta hai , phir wahi tumko us qayamat ke din jamaa karega jiske aane mein koi shakk nahin. Magar aksar log jaante nahin hain

verses.uthmani: وَلِلَّهِ مُلۡكُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ ۚ وَيَوۡمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ يَوۡمَئِذٖ يَخۡسَرُ ٱلۡمُبۡطِلُونَ
verses.indopak: وَلِلّٰهِ مُلْكُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ ۗ وَيَوْمَ تَقُوْمُ السَّاعَةُ يَوْمَٮِٕذٍ يَّخْسَرُ الْمُبْطِلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: walillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi wayawma taqoomu alssa'atu yawmaithin yakhsaru almubtiloona
verses.saheeh: And to Allah belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.
verses.khattab: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. On the Day the Hour will be established, the people of falsehood will then be in ˹total˺ loss
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And to God belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. And on the day when the Hour sets in (yawma taqūmu’l-sā‘atu is substituted by [the following, yawma’idhin]) on that day the followers of falsehood, the disbelievers, will be losers, that is to say, their loss will become manifest by their ending up in the Fire.
verses.romanUrdu: Zameen aur aasmaano ki badshahi Allah hi ki hai, aur jis roz qayamat ki ghadi aa khadi hogi us din baatil parast khasarey (nuksan) mein padh jayenge

verses.uthmani: وَتَرَىٰ كُلَّ أُمَّةٖ جَاثِيَةٗ ۚ كُلُّ أُمَّةٖ تُدۡعَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ كِتَٰبِهَا ٱلۡيَوۡمَ تُجۡزَوۡنَ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.indopak: وَتَرٰى كُلَّ اُمَّةٍ جَاثِيَةً ۗ كُلُّ اُمَّةٍ تُدْعٰۤى اِلٰى كِتٰبِهَا ۗ اَلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَوْنَ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: watara kulla ommatin jathiyatan kullu ommatin tud'a ila kitabiha alyawma tujzawna ma kuntum ta'maloona
verses.saheeh: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
verses.khattab: And you will see every faith-community on its knees. Every community will be summoned to its record ˹of deeds˺. ˹They all will be told,˺ “This Day you will be rewarded for what you used to do
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And you will see every community, that is, [all] members of a religion, crouching, on their knees — or [jāthiya means] ‘gathered together’. Every community will be summoned to its record, the record of its deeds and it will be said to them: ‘Today you will be requited for what you used to do, that is, [you will be given] the desert thereof.
verses.romanUrdu: Us waqt tum har girooh ko ghuthano (knees) ke bal gira dekhoge. Har girooh ko pukara jayega ke aaye aur apna naame aamal dekhe. Unse kaha jayega: “aaj tum logon ko un aamal ka badla diya jayega jo tum karte rahe thay

verses.uthmani: هَٰذَا كِتَٰبُنَا يَنطِقُ عَلَيۡكُم بِٱلۡحَقِّ ۚ إِنَّا كُنَّا نَسۡتَنسِخُ مَا كُنتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُونَ
verses.indopak: هٰذَا كِتٰبُنَا يَنْطِقُ عَلَيْكُمْ بِالْحَقِّ ۗ اِنَّا كُنَّا نَسْتَنْسِخُ مَا كُنْتُمْ تَعْمَلُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: hatha kitabuna yantiqu 'alaykum bialhaqqi inna kunna nastansikhu ma kuntum ta'maloona
verses.saheeh: This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed whatever you used to do."
verses.khattab: This record of Ours speaks the truth about you. Indeed, We always had your deeds recorded ˹by the angels˺.”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿This is Our book, the register of [deeds recorded by] the guardian angels, which pronounces against you with truth. Indeed We used to write down, record and preserve, what you used to do’.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh hamara tayyar karaya hua aamal naama hai jo tumhare upar theek theek shahadat de raha hai, jo kuch bhi tum karte thay usey hum likhwate ja rahe thay”

verses.uthmani: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ وَعَمِلُواْ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ فَيُدۡخِلُهُمۡ رَبُّهُمۡ فِي رَحۡمَتِهِۦ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلۡفَوۡزُ ٱلۡمُبِينُ
verses.indopak: فَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ اٰمَنُوْا وَعَمِلُوا الصّٰلِحٰتِ فَيُدْخِلُهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ فِىْ رَحْمَتِهٖ ۗ ذٰلِكَ هُوَ الْفَوْزُ الْمُبِيْنُ
verses.transliteration: faamma allatheena amanoo wa'amiloo alssalihati fayudkhiluhum rabbuhum fee rahmatihi thalika huwa alfawzu almubeenu
verses.saheeh: So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment.
verses.khattab: As for those who believed and did good, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is ˹truly˺ the absolute triumph
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So as for those who believed and performed righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy, His Paradise. That is the manifest triumph, the clear and evident [triumph].
verses.romanUrdu: Phir jo log imaan laaye thay aur neik aamal karte rahey thay unhein unka Rubb apni rehmat mein dakhil karega. Aur yahi sareeh kaamiyabi hai

verses.uthmani: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓاْ أَفَلَمۡ تَكُنۡ ءَايَٰتِي تُتۡلَىٰ عَلَيۡكُمۡ فَٱسۡتَكۡبَرۡتُمۡ وَكُنتُمۡ قَوۡمٗا مُّجۡرِمِينَ
verses.indopak: وَاَمَّا الَّذِيْنَ كَفَرُوْۤا ۗ اَفَلَمْ تَكُنْ اٰيٰتِىْ تُتْلٰى عَلَيْكُمْ فَاسْتَكْبَرْتُمْ وَكُنْتُمْ قَوْمًا مُّجْرِمِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: waamma allatheena kafaroo afalam takun ayatee tutla 'alaykum faistakbartum wakuntum qawman mujrimeena
verses.saheeh: But as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], "Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a people of criminals?
verses.khattab: And as for those who disbelieved, ˹they will be told,˺ “Were My revelations not recited to you, yet you acted arrogantly and were a wicked people
verses.jalalayn: ﻿But as for those who disbelieved, it will be said to them: ‘Were not My signs, [was not] the Qur'an, recited to you, but you were disdainful, you were arrogant, and were a guilty, a disbelieving, lot?
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jin logon ne kufr kiya tha unsey kaha jayega “kya meri aayat tumko nahin sunayi jaati thin? Magar tumne takabbur kiya aur mujrim bankar rahey

verses.uthmani: وَإِذَا قِيلَ إِنَّ وَعۡدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقّٞ وَٱلسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيۡبَ فِيهَا قُلۡتُم مَّا نَدۡرِي مَا ٱلسَّاعَةُ إِن نَّظُنُّ إِلَّا ظَنّٗا وَمَا نَحۡنُ بِمُسۡتَيۡقِنِينَ
verses.indopak: وَاِذَا قِيْلَ اِنَّ وَعْدَ اللّٰهِ حَقٌّ وَّالسَّاعَةُ لَا رَيْبَ فِيْهَا قُلْتُمْ مَّا نَدْرِىْ مَا السَّاعَةُ ۙ اِنْ نَّـظُنُّ اِلَّا ظَنًّا وَّمَا نَحْنُ بِمُسْتَيْقِنِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: waitha qeela inna wa'da allahi haqqun waalssa'atu la rayba feeha qultum ma nadree ma alssa'atu in nathunnu illa thannan wama nahnu bimustayqineena
verses.saheeh: And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of Allah is truth and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.' "
verses.khattab: And whenever it was said ˹to you˺, ‘Surely Allah’s promise ˹of judgment˺ is true and there is no doubt about the Hour,’ you said ˹mockingly˺, ‘We do not know what the Hour is! We think it is no more than speculation, and we are not convinced ˹that it will ever come˺.’”
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And when it was said, to you, O disbelievers: “God’s promise, of resurrection, is indeed true, and there is no doubt about the Hour”, (read al-sā‘atu or al-sā‘ata) you said, “We do not know what the Hour is. We only make conjectures (al-Mubarrad said that this actually [means] in nahnu illā nazunnu zannan) and we are by no means certain” ’, that it will come to pass.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur jab kaha jaata tha ke Allah ka waada bar- haqq hai aur qayamat ke aane mein koi shakk nahin, to tum kehte thay ke hum nahin jaante qayamat kya hoti hai, hum to bas ek gumaan sa rakhte hain , yaqeen hum ko nahin hai”

verses.uthmani: وَبَدَا لَهُمۡ سَيِّـَٔاتُ مَا عَمِلُواْ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُواْ بِهِۦ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُونَ
verses.indopak: وَبَدَا لَهُمْ سَيِّاٰتُ مَا عَمِلُوْا وَحَاقَ بِهِمْ مَّا كَانُوْا بِهٖ يَسْتَهْزِءُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: wabada lahum sayyiatu ma 'amiloo wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona
verses.saheeh: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
verses.khattab: And the evil ˹consequences˺ of their deeds will unfold before them, and they will be overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And there will appear before them, in the Hereafter, the evils of what they did, in this world, that is to say, the requital thereof, and they will be besieged by, there shall befall [them], what they used to deride, namely, the chastisement [of the Hereafter].
verses.romanUrdu: Us waqt unpar unke aamal ki buraiyan khul jayengi aur woh usi cheez ke pher mein aa jayenge jiska woh mazaak udaya karte thay

verses.uthmani: وَقِيلَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ نَنسَىٰكُمۡ كَمَا نَسِيتُمۡ لِقَآءَ يَوۡمِكُمۡ هَٰذَا وَمَأۡوَىٰكُمُ ٱلنَّارُ وَمَا لَكُم مِّن نَّٰصِرِينَ
verses.indopak: وَقِيْلَ الْيَوْمَ نَنْسٰٮكُمْ كَمَا نَسِيْتُمْ لِقَاۤءَ يَوْمِكُمْ هٰذَا وَمَأْوٰٮكُمُ النَّارُ وَمَا لَـكُمْ مِّنْ نّٰصِرِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: waqeela alyawma nansakum kama naseetum liqaa yawmikum hatha wamawakumu alnnaru wama lakum min nasireena
verses.saheeh: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.
verses.khattab: It will be said, “This Day We will neglect you as you neglected the meeting of this Day of yours! Your home will be the Fire, and you will have no helpers
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And it will be said: ‘Today We will forget you, We will abandon you in the Fire, just as you forgot the encounter of this day of yours, that is to say, [just as] you neglected to perform [those good] deeds [in preparation] for the encounter with it, and your abode will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers, [any] protectors therefrom.
verses.romanUrdu: Aur insey kehdiya jayega ke “Aaj hum bhi usi tarah tumhein bhulaye detay hain jis tarah tum is din ki mulaqaat ko bhool gaye thay.Tumhara thikana ab dozakh hai aur koi tumhari madad karne wala nahin hai

verses.uthmani: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّكُمُ ٱتَّخَذۡتُمۡ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ هُزُوٗا وَغَرَّتۡكُمُ ٱلۡحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنۡيَا ۚ فَٱلۡيَوۡمَ لَا يُخۡرَجُونَ مِنۡهَا وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُونَ
verses.indopak: ذٰلِكُمْ بِاَنَّكُمُ اتَّخَذْتُمْ اٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِ هُزُوًا وَّغَرَّتْكُمُ الْحَيٰوةُ الدُّنْيَا ۚ فَالْيَوْمَ لَا يُخْرَجُوْنَ مِنْهَا وَلَا هُمْ يُسْتَعْتَبُوْنَ
verses.transliteration: thalikum biannakumu ittakhathtum ayati allahi huzuwan wagharratkumu alhayatu alddunya faalyawma la yukhrajoona minha wala hum yusta'taboona
verses.saheeh: That is because you took the verses of Allah in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [Allah].
verses.khattab: This is because you made a mockery of Allah’s revelations, and were deluded by ˹your˺ worldly life.” So ˹from˺ that Day ˹on˺ they will not be taken out of the Fire, nor will they be allowed to appease ˹their Lord˺
verses.jalalayn: ﻿That is because you took God’s signs, the Qur'an, in mockery, and the life of this world deceived you’, to the extent that you said, ‘There is neither Resurrection nor Reckoning’. So today they will not be brought out (read either active yakhrujūna, ‘they will [not] come out’, or passive yukhrajūna, ‘they will [not] be brought out’) of it, of the Fire, nor will they asked to make amends: they will not be asked to [try to] attain the pleasure of their Lord by repenting or being obedient, for such [action] will be of no use then.
verses.romanUrdu: Yeh tumhara anjaam is liye hua hai ke tumne Allah ki aayat ka mazaak bana liya tha aur tumhein duniya ki zindagi ne dhoke mein daal diya tha. Lihaza aaj na yeh log dozakh se nikale jayenge aur na inse kaha jayega ke maafi maang kar apne Rubb ko raazi karo”

verses.uthmani: فَلِلَّهِ ٱلۡحَمۡدُ رَبِّ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَرَبِّ ٱلۡأَرۡضِ رَبِّ ٱلۡعَٰلَمِينَ
verses.indopak: فَلِلّٰهِ الْحَمْدُ رَبِّ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَرَبِّ الْاَرْضِ رَبِّ الْعٰلَمِيْنَ
verses.transliteration: falillahi alhamdu rabbi alssamawati warabbi alardi rabbi al'alameena
verses.saheeh: Then, to Allah belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.
verses.khattab: So all praise is for Allah—Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of all worlds
verses.jalalayn: ﻿So to God belongs [all] praise, the attribution to Him of what is beautiful [in words] for fulfilling His promise regarding the deniers; Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, the Lord of the Worlds, the Creator of all that has been mentioned (‘ālam, ‘world’, denotes everything other than God; it is in the plural [‘ālamīn] because of the different types [of beings] in them; rabbi, ‘Lord’, [in the last clause] is a substitution [for the previous ones]).
verses.romanUrdu: Pas taarif Allah hi ke liye hai jo zameen aur aasmaano ka maalik aur saare jahan waalon ka parwardigar hai

verses.uthmani: وَلَهُ ٱلۡكِبۡرِيَآءُ فِي ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضِ ۖ وَهُوَ ٱلۡعَزِيزُ ٱلۡحَكِيمُ
verses.indopak: وَلَهُ الْكِبْرِيَاۤءُ فِى السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالْاَرْضِ ۗ وَهُوَ الْعَزِيْزُ الْحَكِيْمُ
verses.transliteration: walahu alkibriyao fee alssamawati waalardi wahuwa al'azeezu alhakeemu
verses.saheeh: And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
verses.khattab: To Him belongs ˹all˺ Majesty in the heavens and the earth. And He is the Almighty, All-Wise
verses.jalalayn: ﻿And to Him belongs [all] grandeur, [all] majesty, in the heavens and the earth (fī’l-samāwāti wa’l-ardi is a circumstantial qualifier), and He is the Mighty, the Wise — as [explained in a similar statement] above.
verses.romanUrdu: Zameen aur aasmaano mein badayi usi ke liye hai aur wahi zabardast (most mighty) aur daana(most wise) hai
